claims.quote: One of the syndromic forms of microcephaly is microcephaly, seizures and developmental delay (MCSZ) (OMIM #613402), a rare autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder with a range of phenotypic severity, and known to be caused by mutations in the polynucleotide kinase 3' phosphatase (PNKP) gene.

claims.object_text: repair of single and double stranded DNA breaks
claims.quote: The PNK protein is a key enzyme involved in the repair of single and double stranded DNA breaks, a process which is particularly important in the nervous system.
We used whole exome sequencing to identify homozygosity for a missense c.1385G > C (p.Arg462Pro) mutation in PNKP in the patient

claims.object_text: Arg 462 residue is part of the lid subdomain helix of the P-loop Kinase domain
claims.quote: The Arg 462 residue forms a part of the lid subdomain helix of the P-loop Kinase domain.
